EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Your request for assistance has been reviewed and we've determined that this will be best handled as a Change Order. We have sent the information to the Professional Services team (project number PRXXXXXX), and they will be in touch with you as soon as they're able. The team handles orders based on when they're received, with priority given to payroll impacting and compliance related requests. For all other items, you can expect that they'll begin working on your request within 8 weeks. We appreciate your patience.
If you have questions regarding this change in the meantime, please reach out to our Customer Success Team at BPS.CustomerService@insperity.com. Or, if you have additional questions related to Time & Attendance, please feel free to contact our Support Team at Time.Support@insperity.com; our Support Team will be happy to help.
Thank you,
Time & Attendance Technical Support 8401 Greenway Blvd. Suite 1100 | Middleton, WI 53562 OFFICE: 800-314-8223 | FAX: 262-364-3800
